responsibility: Implements the Resolver2_0 top-level collection pass that builds the initial namespace skeleton for a crate before macro and ordinary name lookup run. This file inserts modules, traits, functions, statics, structs, tuple structs, enums, unions, constants, macros, and related items into the appropriate value/type/macro namespaces with duplicate-definition diagnostics, enters named module and block scopes through ribs, records AST modules in Analysis::Mappings, and resolves use declarations by flattening nested use trees, handling direct imports, rebinds, and glob imports via the helper GlobbingVisitor that exports public names from modules into shadowable namespace entries.
same_name_distinction: Implements the TopLevel collection pass and GlobbingVisitor behavior, including namespace insertion with duplicate diagnostics, module scope traversal, use-tree flattening, direct/glob/rebind import handling, and node-forwarding bookkeeping; the paired header declares those visitors and helper entry points.
